mapper.sql: p.id, p.title, p.difficulty, p.status, p.approach, p.note, p.source, p.url, p.solved_at, p.last_solved_at, p.solve_count, p.review_stage, p.next_review_at, p.created_at, p.updated_at
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM problem p
ORDER BY
p.created_at DESC p.difficulty ASC, p.updated_at DESC p.difficulty DESC, p.updated_at DESC p.next_review_at IS NULL, p.next_review_at ASC p.solved_at IS NULL, p.solved_at DESC p.updated_at DESC
SELECT FROM problem p WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE problem p SET p.status = 'solved', p.last_solved_at = NOW(3), p.solve_count = p.solve_count + 1, p.solved_at = IFNULL(p.solved_at, NOW(3)), p.next_review_at = IFNULL(p.next_review_at, DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL 1 DAY)), p.updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.id IN #{id}
